axes.boundary_generalisation: especially AP-1 vs AP-2 and epistemic vs NP-2
axes.cue_generalisation: relation recognition without re-recognising the family-specific hard cue

interpretation_rule: No global score decides a family. Acceptance/collapse follows pre-registered fold-specific criteria and observed failure modes. Undecidable performance is inconclusive, never retroactive rule adjustment.
leakage_integrity_rule: No new training data from defined test facts before execution. Fold, metric or threshold changes after seeing results are forbidden; changes require a new protocol version.
np2_boundary_precision: epistemic-to-NP-2 verdicts count only on the 3 entity-disjoint NP-2 pairs (NP-2--01/02/03). The Maria/the nonprofit pilot (NP-2--00, overlapping epistemic--00) stays diagnostic/historic and must not carry the boundary decision.
primary_metrics: relation precision/recall/F1 on designated test facts
per fold separately, never aggregated only
scope: no change to v2, expansion freeze or generator
all counterfactual/current gold facts stay test-only
